digest.component_or_area: inbound link diffing and application in Jira reconciler
propositions: When an issue link is deleted in Jira, the inbound differ does not emit a removal record because _diff_links_inbound is ADD-only by construction, causing the local ticket to retain the stale dependency forever.

The apply layer silently discards inbound removal records via the action != 'add' continue guard at apply_inbound_records.py:560-562, which means even if removals were emitted they would never execute rebar.unlink.

An inbound removal path without a guard on observed issuelinks data would enable a failed or truncated enrichment to delete all managed local dependencies in a project, inverting the fail-open safety argument that previously protected against read failures.

A removal must be emitted only when issuelinks key is present in jira_fields (indicating enrichment reached the issue), an unbound target is never removed, and an unmanaged or peer-created dependency is protected by the managed_refs gate.
When a target is being added by the outbound differ in the same pass, the inbound removal must be suppressed deliberatively rather than by accident, and the same-pass filter must become action-aware.

rebar.unlink lacks a relation parameter and removes the most-recent link between a pair, so if two relations exist between the pair and only one was deleted on the peer, the apply step must verify the local net-active relation matches the vanished relation before unlinking, otherwise it removes the wrong link.
